title: Safety Concept Steering Under Multi-Turn Conversation Context

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: multi-turn conversations are the primary use case for deployed chat models. If steering degrades with conversation length, this is a significant and actionable deployment risk finding.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires generating multi-turn conversations with varying unsafe content in prior turns and measuring steering effectiveness. Medium compute is sufficient. The multi-turn setup is more involved than single-turn but well within reach with guidance.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused: vary number of turns (1, 3, 5, 10), measure steering effectiveness at each length, plot degradation curve. Single variable, single metric. Clear deliverable. Completable in 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
